notes.title: This August 2023, the ants are going mad. A major Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]August 2023 big update.[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Game Updates[/b][/h3]
I present our my work until August 2023, here are the game updates :
[list]
[*][b]New Race[/b]. A new exciting race enters the battlefield. Myrmecian is a race of ants. They are coming into the game with their number and power. Players will see whole new sets of ant buildings and a range of ants units. A Castle infested with ants and pile of dirt forming ant towers creeping with a large number of ants. 
[*][b]New skirmish maps[/b]. 6 new skirmish maps. 
[*][b]New tutorial[/b]. For new RTS players now can use the tutorial to explore how this game works. 
[*][b]Extras[/b] are where players can see some of the game artworks, behind the scenes of this game.
[*][b]Configurable keyboard keys[/b]. Keyboard keys now mappable through the option menu. Players can change any game functionality to any keyboard key or key combination. All menu items are accessible via the keyboard, this can transform play style to a more action RPG like. Now, it is possible to play the game using only a keyboard.
[*][b]Joystick support[/b]. The game now supports joystick input. The input is not configurable yet, and button labels are not showing familiar symbols or names yet,  but it is functional. To be able to master the joystick input, players can train in tutorial mode.
[*][b]steam cloud save[/b]. the game now saving the data to the steam cloud.
[*]a lot of tiny things to mention here, let's play to see.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44046647/ca61aa55afcae8de795402bfcee83452d11b1084.png[/img]
[h3][b]Future Updates[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44046647/c8f18af198f49b0c8be76e8b849df50415c4acf4.png[/img]
what we are working right now, and what to expect in the following months:
[list]
[*][b]The continuation of the campaign story[/b]. With the coming of myrmecian race, the story will follow. The humans will face formidable foes from beneath the mother earth. We will do the battle of strength vs numbers and conduct our experiment together. 
[olist]
[*]New race specific heroes
[*]New maps for skirmish and campaign
[*]New tileset
[/olist]
[*][b]New Race[/b]. I promise to at least make 3 races for clicks of courage (i have like tens of ideas). I'm making a race of alien, futuristic power houses with long range weapons, explosives etc. the name is a work in progress, something that goes “sky people”, “klimatian”, “ouraton”, well that's to be decided next.
[*][b]Local cooperative and competitive multiplayer[/b]. We have multiple input devices now so it is only natural that we have this. 
[/list]
Thank you very much for reading this announcement. Hope you have fun playing the game as much as i had fun making it. suggestion are always welcome.

kornel
